items.html: However, the second correction that was added to Samael, ZA of the Klipa of Atzilut, is that he also spread out and became a complete Partzuf in his ten Sefirot, which at first he was not, only VAK alone. However, in the matter of the lights, which are the spirituality within his nine Sefirot, nothing was added to him, and he has only the aspect of the six lights of spirituality that were his before the correction. For we have already stated above that he has no Daat. Therefore the lights are only six, and these six lights illuminate in the ten Sefirot.
